chunks: And it strengthens that which Abu Ali Muhammad ibn Hammam narrated from Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Malik from Umar ibn Tarqan from Muhammad ibn Ismail from Ali ibn Umar ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Indeed, the Master of God will live a lifespan of one hundred and twenty years, like Prophet Ibrahim (the Friend), and he will appear in the form of a young man who has completed thirty years.
ai.seo_question: What is the expected lifespan and appearance of the Imam of the Age according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* highlights the miraculous preservation of the Imam of the Age, emphasizing a lifespan of 120 years that mirrors Prophet Ibrahim’s longevity while maintaining the vigor of youth. This duality of age and vitality serves as a key eschatological sign, reinforcing the concept of *ghayba* (occultation) where the Imam remains hidden yet alive among his followers. The comparison to Ibrahim underscores the Imam’s role as a spiritual heir to the patriarchs, embodying both wisdom and enduring strength.
